reviews.reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands as an ordered, fully occupied four-atom primitive P4mm (No. 99) cell with a=b=3.942278 A, c=6.220783 A, V=96.6806 A^3, Z=1, and reduced composition Zr2TeS; primitive/conventional standardization does not reveal a distinct supercell. Indexing covers all 27 important lines (M20=236.5), with no important unmatched observed reflection. An independent whole-profile calculation from the instantiated CIF gives Rprofile=0.0379 versus 0.0371 for a Pawley-like fit using the same global line shape and freely fitted reflection intensities; the free and CIF integrated intensities correlate at 0.99995 with relative amplitude residual 0.0083. Thus the atomic coordinates and element ordering, not merely peak positions, are established. Searches over the onefold-axis orderings leave only origin/inversion/identical-Zr-label equivalents of this realization at the best fit; distinct orderings fit substantially worse. Complete periodic neighbor shells show no overlaps (no pair below 2.7 A), plausible Zr-S/Te contacts, full stoichiometry, and no chemistry veto. No concrete diffraction-compatible incompatible realization survives outside the submitted set.
